reviews.text: Excellent communication and service. I was flying into Fort Worth for a specific 4-part kitchen project. Jonathon made sure my project agenda was known ahead of time and then Clint arrived on time and worked most of the day. Clint's work was exceptional, and thoughtful on how the project needed to progress. The end result was fantastic and a much improved kitchen work envrionment. When finished, Clint summarized the work on the invoice and reviewed each component of the project to my satisfactio

Service Company Plumbing replaced water line and sewer line to the house.  They were very prompt and responsive.  The crew kept a very neat job site, and they kept the area of disturbance to a minimum.   The work was completed quickly and the disruption to service was surprising short - only a couple hours.  Last, the employees were all very police and respectful.  Great experience overall, and I highly recommend them!

Mike Creager's Services Co. Plumbing is the best plumbing company we have ever dealt with. Mike and his team (Diego was our plumber) are honest, efficient and very thorough. Diego got on the phone with the manufacturer to trouble shoot problems with our water softener, tried everything they recommended before discussing replacement. They provided multiple options for replacing/repairing our system. Diego is a really nice young man that loves what he does, helping the customer solve problems! Ref

We’ve had Service Co out a number of times working on a variety of projects both indoor and outdoor. Clint, specifically, is an incredible employee. He is genuine, gives options, and fully explains everything he will be working on. We know we can always count on them to show up in a timely manner and to fix our issues quickly. Thank you for doing such quality work with the BEST customer service, Clint!

Random find:  looking out the window while making coffee and saw their truck in my neighborhood.  I called,  and my water leak at my office was fixed! Not cheap,  but not outrageous, and you truly get what you pay for.... good job and no hassle.  I highly recommend.

Diego Reyes did an excellent job fixing my water heater. He was punctual, friendly, and made sure everything was installed correctly. I really appreciated how fast and efficient he was. Highly recommend!
Just the best! The whole team is so professional and friendly. Response time is excellent and the work they do it above and beyond. We'll never use anyone else.

Mike only hires the best; Clint did an extensively thorough inspection of my current plumbing and discovered major deficiencies that were present. The other companies wanted to charge for testing without even entering the crawl space, but Clint found all the faults through a visual inspection. Clint was an absolute Godsend; he was empathetic, through, and a pleasure to be in his presence. He ran into more issues while doing a full drain replacement, but if those things didn't pop up, I might not

THE BEST! Excellent customer service and they definitely know what they are doing and offer fair prices.  Alec helped me out so much this weekend (with little notice) and always has a smile. Highly recommend!

Great experience with Service Company Plumbing. I had a call from my wife notifying me that water was everywhere when I couldn’t get a way from work. Service Company came out and handled the situation professionally, Diego and Mike were very informative with my wife though out the process. Would highly recommend.

Service Company Plumbing never fails to take care of my needs.
I have used them for years and have always been very happy with the service.  Have recommended them to many people. The experience from scheduling with Jonathan, to watching Alek work, and for the services is seamless and easy.  HIGHLY RECOMMEND.  Thanks to Mike and his entire crew for being my GO TO plumbers.
Oscar and service company plumbing has been fabulous for all my needs. I highlight recommend them.

Alek called and arrived right on time. He was very professional and did a "GREAT JOB." I have used a couple of plumbers, and they do not even come close to Alek. If I could give him more than 5 stars I would. So happy I finally found a plumber I can trust. Thanks Alek

They have so far done exactly what they said they would do. We still have to finish the project, but everything is going very well. Diego came out and gave us a good bid. Clint came out and started the installation. He also was very good.

Service Plumbing installed a new gas line from the meter in the alley to the house for us.  Mike came out and spent time explaining the work to be done and discussed options so we knew what to expect.  They came right away and Diego and his team were extremely professional, efficient and courteous.  They were careful with their work and cleaned up the job site perfectly.  Highly recommend!

Clint was great to work with yesterday! He thoroughly explained the issue we were having and how he was going to fix it. We are very pleased with the service we received, and will gladly call Service Company Plumbing again for any future needs. We are already repeat customers.

A very kind group of young men did an excellent job. I appreciate everything they did for me so far so good thank you. And in the future if I need a Plumber, they will be the first ones I call so thank you thank you thank you

Diego came and fixed the clogged pipe.  He was professional, friendly, and skilled.
Thanks Diego!
Clint was prompt and efficient. He communicated very well about the service needed and scheduling.
Diego was very knowledgable about dehumidifers and how to install in my crawl space!!  Very happy with his work!
Diego was super friendly. Very communicative through the whole repair, and the cost was very reasonable.
Everyone I’ve met from Service Vompany Plumbers has been so nice. We call them the Yes Ma’am or Yes Sir plumbers so polite. Diego was no exception.  His work was spot on and he was personable.
Sam was terrific.  He did a great job installing the shower hardware.  This is the third time I've used Service Company Plumbing and all three times they exceeded expectations.
Diego, with Service Company, did an amazing job at fixing my plumbing issue! This company is very quick to respond and schedule me in! They clean up after and are very polite! Highly recommend!!

Mike, Diego, and Clint were so great to help us fix a leak in our front yard our line that was costing us a fortune on our water bill! They were so professional, found it, and fixed it so quickly and you could barely tell they were there! So thankful for their quick work and getting our house back to operating how it should!
Phoned them in the morning and had help by noon. Diego was efficient and did a great job explaining what he did to solve the problem. He also did a great job cleaning up afterwards.

We got a new water heater system installed and could not be happier with Service Company Plumbing. Clint was great! He was on time, thorough, and took the time to explain the install process and answer all of our questions. Thanks again Clint!

Service Company Plumbing is a local business that is very popular in Ryan Place -- they are familiar with many houses and will provide extensive feedback concerning the issue you call them with and any other related plumbing issues.  They are thorough, completely reliable, professional and friendly to work with.  I heartily recommend them.

Simply the best! After being told by another local plumber they couldn't help us for 6 weeks, Alek was on top of things the same day & next day. He connected us with a restoration company for the water damage from our leak, who has worked wonderfully with our insurance, and made this entire process painless for us. This company has done work for me 2 times now and I am so freaking impressed with them. Sam came out to do a smoke test and leak detection for a business and I won’t use another plumber. The quality of work and amazing customer service coupled with affordable pricing is unbeatable. Give this company a try. You won’t regret it!

Service Co. Plumbing is great! This is a second job they have completed for me and I couldn't be happier! I needed a water line added to connect to a new garage and they were able to fit me in right away. Alek was so polite and knowledgable about what needed to be done and he went right to work digging a trench through clay and rocks in this terrible heat! I highly recommend this company!

Can’t recommend this company enough. They’re honest, reliable, responsive, and the cherry on top is that they are so kind. They always explain things thoroughly and do their best to work within necessary timelines. Call them! You will not be disappointed.

My technician was Clint Cranston and he was prompt, efficient, personable and highly effective. He found a leak in the attic water
Pipes and fixed it within minutes. I am totally pleased with Clint’s service.  I will call Service Company for future plumbing  needs and ask for Clint.
Diego was the best technician I have ever worked with. Got here quick, finished the job fast, and it didn’t over charge. Highly recommend

Diego some of the best customer service ahead, great pricing,  i will always use for any of my plumbing needs, Diego was very, very helpful. And super caring.he cares about his job and the customers he helps which is hard to find now a days in people
I've now dealt with 3 different ttechs on a total of 5 occasions.  They have all be great.  Sam was the overachiever in drain hair removal though.  100% fire Sam.  Champion status.

I worked with Mike Creager and Alek Reeves on 2 major projects over the last few months.  While one is rarely happy about spending money on plumbing, they performed work as needed professionally,  responsibly, and responsively. They were respectful of minimizing inconvenience to me and did a great job. I would recommend Service Company Plumbing to others.

Had plumbing issues with water backing up in our 1960s house - Service Plumbing made us a priority, got out quickly that day and got the water back down. They came back with two other preventive actions that were somewhat costly, but I believe fair. Alec was extremely professional, friendly and was very conscientious to not make a mess and keep our house clean. Would definitely recommend them.
Sam’s been out twice for us and has been great.
After calling for busted pipes after a freeze, Sam arrived very quickly, and worked just as fast. Very courteous and professional. 10/10 Will call again for any future plumbing needs

The most professional outfit I have ever had in my house.  I needed some help with a potential emergency and Service Company Plumbing jumped right on top of it. I was particularly impressed with how Alec walked me through every step of the process including showing me what was on the camera as he examined our plumbing system.  We won't use anyone else in the future.

Everyone that came out to the job was very professional and respectful. The owner, Mike stopped by daily to check on things and walk me through each step. They are incredible with communication, letting you know when they are coming to your home/leaving/estimated time of job completion for the day. They spend extra time cleaning the job area and making sure everything is tidy before heading out. Overall great experience.

This is the most professional and fair plumbing company I’ve ever dealt with. I’ve had them out twice so far and they’re doing a big project on my bath tub. They’re always on time, courteous, and prices are very fair! As a woman that’s alone during the day, im always anxious about service people in the house but I felt safe letting them in to my house. They’re great all around!!

Would 100% recommend using this company and Alek. We had an improperly installed toilet, he came out and quoted us for the repair. He was able to come by the following week to complete the job. Very professional, respectful and did a fantastic job fixing our issue. He even helped fix a small issue with our sink at no extra cost. Will definitely be using his services again.

We highly recommend Service Company Plumbing for all your plumbing needs from small jobs to huge jobs. We had a tankless water heater installed and we couldn't be happier with the finished product. The crew was so polite and made sure we understood the complete process.A company with integrity !!!

Clint put in the extra effort all the way thru to run our new gas line.  ...Crawled deep into attic to be sure of needs/specs.   ...Spent extra time w me investigating options.  ...Put my garage "furniture" back upon completion.   Very fair price.  Very good service.

Mike and his guys are outstanding at what they do.  In addition to all the things they do, for us they were replacing a city required back flow preventer.  This device requires a licensed plumber and permit for installation and a visit from a city inspector after install.  When finished I couldn't tell they had been here(meaning they cleaned up after themselves and left everything the way it was when they showed up), except now my valve passed and the city stopped harassing me about it.   Ultima

I can't say enough good things about Service Company Plumbing!!  Everyone is so polite, helpful, and knowledgeable!  Thank you for replacing my water line from the meter to my house.  Big Deal 💯. And getting it finished at least a day ahead of time ❤️ …

Emergancy repairs to Projects and remodels. I have recommended them to my family members and coworkers. Alek has only been to my location for a few years but he hold the same values that I received when Mike started the process 11 years ago.
